messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered for service `inference-canary` — alert: canary 5xx-rate > 8% (us-west) — rule: canary-5xx-threshold. link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC12345 created and paging rotation `oncall-sre` (page fired). Escalation in 5m if not acknowledged.

jen-sre: acked. I'm on it. grabbing logs now.

maria-eng: hey — that rollout started 3m ago, canary image `embed-quant:v20260315-7f3a`. I see a spike in `quant_kernel` OOMs in the canary pool right after traffic shift.

jen-sre: seeing same. p99 latency up, and 502/503s from the quant worker processes. stack traces show `kv_cache` allocation failures. past hour baseline was ~0.5% errors, now ~10%.

tom-oncall: @maria-eng can you pause the rollout? runbook step 2: pause and divert.

maria-eng: running `rbctl pause-rollout --name embed-quant-canary --by user=maria`. returned OK. diverting traffic: `routectl set-fraction --service inference-canary --to fallback-variant --fraction 1.0`

infra-bot: Traffic diversion executed: 100% to `fallback-variant` for service `inference-canary`. Autoscaling unchanged.

jen-sre: good. can everyone confirm customer impact? any external 503s or SLOs violated?

alan-support: support queue — two early-access customers reported 5xx errors around 09:14. Tickets: #SUP-1023, #SUP-1024. No public incident yet.

alex-englead: sounds like a production-facing regression. If canary was receiving 2% of traffic and errored at 10% we may have exposed internal beta users. good catch. We'll rollback if errors persist after diversion.

maria-eng: logs from canary host group: repeated allocation failures when quant kernel requests exceed 1.2M active tokens. suspect regression from new kernel selection heuristics in v20260315. Sample log: ```
E 09:13:42 quant_kernel.cpp:231 alloc failed: requested 134217728 bytes
E 09:13:42 model_serving.cpp:98 worker exit code 137
```

jen-sre: ok plan: 1) keep diversion in place 2) stop canary autoscaler to avoid churn 3) rollback canary to previous image if we see more OOMs 4) gather pcap/logs for postmortem.

tom-oncall: I'll disable canary autoscaling: `asgctl set-autoscale embed-canary --min 0 --max 0` — doing now.

infra-bot: Autoscaling adjustment applied: min=0 max=0 for `embed-canary`.

maria-eng: last check: still seeing 3 OOMs in last 2m after diversion, probably backlog. starting a graceful drain of canary nodes: `rbctl drain-nodes --group embed-canary --grace 60s`

jen-sre: I'm updating the incident page and marking customer impact: "limited beta customer 5xxs, short window, mitigation applied (traffic diverted)." setting severity: sev2 for now until we confirm rollback.

alan-support: told customers the team is investigating and we diverted traffic, next update in 15m.

pagerduty-bot: INC12345 acknowledged by jen-sre at 09:16. Escalation timer stopped.

maria-eng: starting rollback of canary to `embed-quant:v20260310-2b9c` per rollback checklist. `rbctl rollback --name embed-quant-canary --image embed-quant:v20260310-2b9c --force` — in progress.

infra-bot: Rollback job queued in cluster `us-west` with job id rb-98765.

jen-sre: any signs of broader regional impact? metrics show no spike in other regions. good.

alex-englead: once rollback completes, let's validate with synthetic traffic (small canary smoke) and then resume staged rollout with 30s ramp and extra gating.

maria-eng: rollback completed on 6 nodes, healthchecks passing on the fallback image. p95 latency back to normal, 5xx-rate down to baseline.

jen-sre: confirming: 5xx rate returned to ~0.7% for canary pool after rollback. Clearing immediate mitigation steps.

tom-oncall: marking incident as mitigated. I'll hand off to oncall-followup for postmortem. @alex-englead want to lead investigation into kernel heuristics change?

alex-englead: I'll take it. primary hypothesis: kernel selection change in v20260315 increases memory footprint under certain token distributions. action: create ticket INF-2042 with triage steps.

jen-sre: created INF-2042 and assigned to @alex-englead. Also PR checklist: add canary memory pressure test to CI, add healthcheck gating to rollout pipeline, and add alert suppression window for transient OOMs.

alan-support: posting final customer update: "We temporarily diverted traffic and rolled back to a stable canary image. A small set of early-access customers saw 5xx errors for ~6 minutes. No broader impact. We're investigating root cause and will follow up"

incident-bot: Incident INC12345 status: mitigated. Postmortem owner: alex-englead. Next update due in 24h.

jen-sre: thumbs up. i'll close the pager on my side. please add logs and heap dumps to INF-2042.

maria-eng: adding kernel traces and sample request payloads to the ticket. thanks everyone — great fast response. :thumbsup:

alan-support: closing support loop, will monitor for customer replies.

jen-sre: last check at 09:31 — all looks stable. moving thread to follow-up channel in 30m.

infra-bot: Note: automated post-incident runbook reminder scheduled in 24h for `create mem-pressure test` task."
